review_candidates.title: Chief Technology Officer
review_candidates.description: Swiffy Technologies is a fast-growing payments technology company building secure, scalable payment infrastructure for businesses operating across multiple markets. As Swiffy continues to scale its transaction volumes, technology platform, integrations and geographic footprint, we are looking for an experienced Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to take ownership of our technology strategy, architecture and engineering function. This is a hands-on technology leadership role. We are looking for someone who can operate strategically at executive level while remaining technically close enough to the platform to challenge architectural decisions, troubleshoot complex issues and guide engineers. The Role The CTO will be responsible for the overall technology strategy and technical direction of Swiffy. You will own the architecture, reliability, security and scalability of our payments platform and lead the engineering team as we continue to grow. Our backend infrastructure is primarily built on AWS, using a serverless architecture incorporating Laravel and AWS Lambda, alongside integrations with banks, payment providers and other financial infrastructure. The successful candidate should have extensive experience designing and operating highly available, transaction-intensive systems where security, uptime, performance and data integrity are critical. Key Responsibilities Technology Strategy & Architecture • Define and own Swiffy’s overall technology strategy and roadmap. • Take responsibility for the architecture and evolution of our AWS environment. • Ensure our infrastructure can scale reliably as transaction volumes and geographic operations grow. • Lead architectural decisions around serverless infrastructure, microservices, APIs, databases, queues, event-driven systems and third-party integrations. • Identify and eliminate technical debt, architectural bottlenecks and single points of failure. • Evaluate emerging technologies where they can meaningfully improve the Swiffy platform. AWS & Platform Engineering • Own the architecture, performance and resilience of our AWS infrastructure. • Provide technical leadership across AWS Lambda, Laravel and serverless/event-driven architectures. • Ensure appropriate use of AWS services for compute, storage, databases, networking, messaging, monitoring and security. • Establish strong infrastructure-as-code, deployment and environment-management practices. • Optimise AWS infrastructure for performance, resilience and cost efficiency. • Design systems capable of handling significant transaction volumes with appropriate redundancy and failover. Payments & Integrations • Oversee technical integrations with banks, payment processors, card networks and other financial infrastructure. • Ensure APIs and payment flows are reliable, secure and properly monitored. • Develop strong reconciliation, transaction-tracking and exception-handling architecture. • Ensure systems are designed to prevent transaction duplication, data loss and inconsistent payment states. • Lead technical due diligence for new banking, payment and technology partnerships. Security, Compliance & Risk • Own the company’s technology security strategy. • Establish strong cybersecurity, access-control, encryption, logging and monitoring practices. • Ensure appropriate controls around sensitive financial and customer data. • Work closely with Risk, Compliance and banking partners on technical and security requirements. • Drive Swiffy towards industry-leading security and compliance standards, including relevant PCI DSS requirements. • Own disaster recovery, business continuity and incident-response planning from a technology perspective. • Conduct regular security and infrastructure reviews and ensure vulnerabilities are addressed quickly. Reliability & Observability • Establish clear standards for platform uptime, latency and reliability. • Implement comprehensive monitoring, alerting, logging and observability across the platform. • Establish measurable SLAs/SLOs for critical services. • Lead the technical response to major production incidents. • Implement effective post-incident reviews and ensure root causes are permanently addressed. • Build infrastructure capable of detecting issues before they materially affect merchants or payment processing. Engineering Leadership • Lead, mentor and develop Swiffy’s engineering and technical teams. • Establish strong engineering standards covering architecture, code quality, testing, documentation and deployment. • Recruit high-quality engineers as the technology team expands. • Implement appropriate code-review and software-development practices. • Create clear ownership and accountability across engineering. • Develop future technical leaders within the organisation. Executive Leadership • Work directly with Swiffy’s founders and executive leadership team. • Translate commercial strategy into technology priorities and execution plans. • Provide clear visibility on technology performance, risks, projects and resource requirements. • Participate in strategic discussions with banks, enterprise partners and technology providers. • Help determine technology budgets and investment priorities. • Ensure technology remains an enabler of Swiffy’s growth rather than a constraint. Required Experience We are looking for someone with approximately 10+ years of software engineering/technology experience, including significant senior technical leadership experience. The ideal candidate will have: • Strong hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS). • Advanced knowledge of PHP and the Laravel Framework • Extensive experience with AWS Lambda and serverless architectures. • Strong understanding of distributed and event-driven systems. • Experience designing high-volume APIs and transactional systems. • Strong understanding of databases, caching, queues and asynchronous processing. • Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code. • Strong knowledge of cloud security and cybersecurity. • Experience designing highly available, fault-tolerant systems. • Experience leading and scaling engineering teams. • Proven experience managing mission-critical production environments. Highly Advantageous Experience within any of the following would be particularly valuable: • Fintech • Payment gateways or payment service providers • Banking technology • Card acquiring • Payment orchestration • High-volume transaction processing • Fraud and risk systems • PCI DSS environments • Financial reconciliation systems • Multi-country payment infrastructure Technical Environment Candidates should be comfortable working within an environment incorporating technologies such as: AWS | Laravel | Node.js Tooling | AWS Lambda | REST APIs | Serverless Architecture | Event-Driven Architecture | Databases (AWS RDS Aurora) | Queues & Messaging | CI/CD | Infrastructure as Code | Cloud Monitoring & Observability Exact AWS services will continue to evolve as the platform grows, and the CTO will be expected to help determine the appropriate architecture. What We’re Looking For This role will suit someone who is: • Technically exceptional – capable of challenging senior engineers and making difficult architectural decisions. • Hands-on – willing to investigate production issues and architecture rather than managing entirely through others. • Commercially minded – understands that technology exists to support customers and business growth. • Security obsessed – particularly when dealing with payments and financial data. • Calm under pressure – capable of leading the response when critical payment infrastructure experiences problems. • Pragmatic – knows when to build, when to buy and when simplicity is better than engineering complexity. • Accountable – takes ownership of the platform rather than simply managing a development team. • Scalability focused – thinks about what the architecture needs to look like at 10x or 100x today’s transaction volumes. The Opportunity This is an opportunity to take ownership of the technology function of a growing African fintech business at an important stage of its development. The CTO will have significant influence over Swiffy’s future architecture, engineering organisation and technology strategy as the company expands its payment capabilities, transaction volumes and international footprint. We are looking for someone who wants to build the technology organisation required for Swiffy’s next stage of growth — not simply maintain what already exists.
